packs: math

=== sqrt
needs host-math
(sqrt 16)
--- want
4

=== sqrt negative
needs host-math
(sqrt -1)
--- error
--- at 1:1
--- message sqrt of negative number

=== abs negative
(abs -5)
--- want
5

=== abs positive
(abs 5)
--- want
5

=== floor
(floor 2.7)
--- want
2

=== floor negative
(floor -2.7)
--- want
-3

=== ceil
(ceil 2.1)
--- want
3

=== round half up
(round 2.5)
--- want
3

=== round half away from zero
(round -2.5)
--- want
-3

=== to-int truncates
(to-int 2.7)
--- want
2

=== to-int truncates toward zero
(to-int -2.7)
--- want
-2

=== math-min
(math-min 3 1 2)
--- want
1

=== math-max
(math-max 3 1 2)
--- want
3

=== math-min needs an argument
(math-min)
--- error
--- at 1:1
--- message math-min expects at least 1 argument

=== pi
(> (pi) 3.14159)
--- want
#t

=== e
(> (e) 2.718)
--- want
#t

=== exp and log round-trip
needs host-math
(round (log (exp 3)))
--- want
3

=== log10
needs host-math
(log10 1000)
--- want
3

=== sin zero
needs host-math
(sin 0)
--- want
0

=== cos zero
needs host-math
(cos 0)
--- want
1

=== tan zero
needs host-math
(tan 0)
--- want
0

# The edges: NaN, the infinities, the sign of zero, and numbers past int64.
# A zero's sign shows only in its text, so those cases compare strings.

=== math-max skips NaN
(math-max 1 (number "nan") 2)
--- want
2

=== math-min skips NaN
(math-min 1 (number "nan") 2)
--- want
1

=== math-max with minus infinity
(math-max (number "-inf") -5)
--- want
-5

=== math-min with infinity
(math-min (number "inf") 5)
--- want
5

=== math-max of one number
(math-max 7)
--- want
7

=== math-max needs numbers
(math-max 1 "a")
--- error
--- at 1:1
--- message expected number, got string

=== abs of minus infinity
(abs (number "-inf"))
--- want
(number "inf")

=== abs of NaN
(abs (number "nan"))
--- want
(number "nan")

=== abs needs a number
(abs "x")
--- error
--- at 1:1
--- message expected number, got string

=== floor of minus a half
(floor -0.5)
--- want
-1

=== ceil keeps the sign of zero
(string (ceil -0.5))
--- want
"-0"

=== round keeps the sign of zero
(string (round -0.4))
--- want
"-0"

=== ceil of infinity
(ceil (number "inf"))
--- want
(number "inf")

=== round of NaN
(round (number "nan"))
--- want
(number "nan")

=== to-int of NaN is NaN
(to-int (number "nan"))
--- want
(number "nan")

=== to-int of infinity is infinity
(to-int (number "-inf"))
--- want
(number "-inf")

=== to-int past int64 keeps the number
(to-int 1e300)
--- want
1e300

=== to-int keeps the sign of zero
(string (to-int -0.4))
--- want
"-0"

=== pi to the last digit
(pi)
--- want
3.141592653589793

=== e to the last digit
(e)
--- want
2.718281828459045

=== exp of zero
needs host-math
(exp 0)
--- want
1

=== exp of minus infinity
needs host-math
(exp (number "-inf"))
--- want
0

=== exp past the doubles
needs host-math
(exp 1000)
--- want
(number "inf")

=== log of zero
needs host-math
(log 0)
--- error
--- at 1:1
--- message log of non-positive number

=== log10 of a power of ten
needs host-math
(log10 1000)
--- want
3

=== log10 of zero
needs host-math
(log10 0)
--- error
--- at 1:1
--- message log10 of non-positive number

=== sin of infinity is NaN
needs host-math
(sin (number "inf"))
--- want
(number "nan")

=== cos of NaN is NaN
needs host-math
(cos (number "nan"))
--- want
(number "nan")

=== sqrt of infinity
needs host-math
(sqrt (number "inf"))
--- want
(number "inf")

=== sqrt keeps minus zero
needs host-math
(string (sqrt -0))
--- want
"-0"
